integrity: A complete algebraic proof is provided. A directly constructed operator-frame matrix was checked numerically for 32 designs across dimensions 3 through 10. Finite computations supplement, not replace, the unrestricted theorem.
scientific_limitations: Full labelled cyclic time-frequency orbits; exactly two nonzero entries per unit window; optimality over minimum-cardinality injective sets, with Hilbert--Schmidt input and unweighted Euclidean data. No assertion of nonlinear stability or general-noise optimality. Full primary text for the multiwindow quantum-injectivity source was inaccessible; independent priority review is pending.
title: Sharp stability and all optimal minimal two-sparse multiwindow Gabor tomography designs
